events.body: Hi, any update on DL-47745? It was meant to come Wednesday. Thanks.

For your notes, since you asked: there is no written rule on our side for refused parcels. Sometimes Returns have them sent back to us, sometimes they get re-attempted if the customer changes their mind, and low-value stuff has been binned at the depot before now. Returns authorisations decide each one.

Thanks,
Ebony
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
My parcel DL-24997 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

DL-2471 refused at the door today 13:25. Driver note: recipient said 'not what I ordered, take it back', carton unopened. It is on our refusals shelf. We hold refusals 5 working days and need one instruction from the merchant: re-attempt, return to sender, or dispose. With no instruction it stays on the shelf and storage is charged to the merchant account from day 6.

Thanks,
Aurelio
